text: Approval of a direct investment is recommended which demonstrates the potential for appropriate risk-adjusted return and strong alignment with Toronto Atmospheric Fund's mandate. The proposed investment of up to net $2,500,000 and gross $3,120,000.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved an investment of up to net $2,500,000 and gross $3,120,000 subject to the terms and conditions outlined by the Investment Committee at its meeting of 18 June 2020 and as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 13, 2020) from the Chair, Investment Committee. 2. Approved, based on the final plan and energy savings estimates, the need to re-present the transaction to the Investment Committee / Board for approval prior to final commitment only if the final project returns to TAF fall below the outlined risk spread of 3 percent or the capital cost varies by greater than 5 percent over the net $2,500,000 investment. 3.
